experiment.name: steady-state incremental update propagation
experiment.setup: r1 seeds baseline OR-Set items; replicas synchronise to quiescence; then r1 adds one new task
experiment.measurement_window: only the single update broadcast/delivery round after baseline metrics are reset
experiment.payload_definition: UTF-8 bytes of serialised message payloads; excludes network framing and transport overhead
experiment.latency_definition: local receiver merge latency measured by the simulator; not end-to-end network latency
